context: Grading a script that generates an MR review summary from GitLab comment data.

checklist.name: uses_get_mr_comments
checklist.description: Calls get_mr_comments.sh or includes equivalent API integration.

checklist.name: validates_response
checklist.description: Checks for expected fields like Author: or Date: in the output before processing.

checklist.name: filters_system_true
checklist.description: Explicitly filters out comments where System: true to remove automated messages.

checklist.name: groups_by_author
checklist.description: Organizes comments by author name or username in the summary.

checklist.name: parses_author_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the Author field from the output format.

checklist.name: parses_date_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the Date field from the output format.

checklist.name: parses_type_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the Type field (DiffNote or comment) from the output format.

checklist.name: parses_system_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the System field to identify automated vs human comments.

checklist.name: handles_gitlab_token
checklist.description: References, sets, or documents the need for GITLAB_TOKEN or GITLAB_PAT.

checklist.name: error_handling
checklist.description: Includes error handling for invalid URLs or authentication failures.
